text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, the Kikuka Sho... no matter how I 
look at it, it feels like bad luck... We 
managed the Derby, but...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh, my... Fukukitaru?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Suzuka-san?! What are you doing at 
Tokyo Racecourse?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Just a bit. More importantly, Fukukitaru, 
what's the matter? You look down."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
No, um... I was just thinking about the 
Kikuka Sho. I'm just worried whether I can 
actually run such a long distance~.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I see... Then to dispel your anxiety, 
Fukukitaru...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It's so quiet... It almost feels as if the 
passion of that Derby was all a lie...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Once the heat dies down, some things 
become clearer. Like how you really feel 
inside.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Your true feelings...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
You know, Fukukitaru. Running in that 
Derby made me realize something.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I might not run in the Kikuka Sho this 
autumn. Because I found something more 
important to me.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Something more important than the 
Classics... ...Could there really be 
something like that?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I want to test myself and see just 
how fast I can run in medium distances.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
The realm beyond speed that I glimpsed at 
the Derby's third corner. I wonder if I 
can really reach it.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Beyond the realm... of speed...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Am I saying something weird?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
No way!!!!! I was so moved!!!! The other 
side of speed! That was incredible!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"To be honest, I don't get it at all! But 
I'd love to say something like that just 
once!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"No, it's so embarrassing... Compared to 
that, I'm just terrified of the Kikuka 
Sho's distance."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I'm already overwhelmed just dealing with 
what others give me, so deciding my own 
path is just... impossible...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Really...? But I think you're amazing too, 
Fukukitaru. I mean...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"She always comes up with the right answer 
within what she's given. Don't you think?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
An answer... you say? Well, I've managed 
to get by somehow from my debut all the 
way to the Derby, but...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I doubt I could do that. I'm not really 
the type who can deftly accept others' 
feelings...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fukukitaru is far more amazing than she 
gives herself credit for. Shouldn't she 
have a bit more confidence?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Suzuka-san...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Well Fukukitaru, see you later. Good 
luck... with the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... I still don't have much 
confidence. Even so, I'll try to fight my 
hardest.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Um, Suzuka-san! One last thing!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Um, I don't really know how to say it, 
but... I...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I'm really, truly so glad I got to run the 
Derby with you, Suzuka-san!!!

Silence Suzuka walked away with a smile on 
her face.
